references.text: Jesus is brought to the high priest, which resembles the situation in Mark.
Jesus is brought to the high priest's house, a parallel event.
Jesus is first brought to Annas, who is related to the high priest, before he is brought to the high priest.
The gathering of leaders against the Lord's anointed can be seen as a foreshadowing of the event in Mark.
The prophecy that the Messiah will be despised and forsaken by people, which is reflected in Jesus' arrest and trial.
